$comment: Phase 4 (People flow) reference configuration for onboarding a professional-body issuer tenant. Schemas are bootstrapped automatically by the platform (Phase4SchemaBootstrap); this file documents the tenant-level settings an operator applies: DID, issuer key, schemas, trust entries and consent scopes. No secrets belong here — keys are generated by the platform and API keys are provisioned out of band.

tenant.description: Professional-body issuer tenant (e.g. HKIE) issuing hkt_profcred_v1 qualification credentials

issuer.$comment: Create via POST /didvc/dids {tenantId, domain, path, algorithm}; the platform generates the key material (public JWK only persisted).

schemas.$comment: Bootstrapped automatically; residency checks are issued by immigration-linked tenants, not professional bodies.

trustEntries.$comment: Register per relying tenant via POST /didvc/trust-entries so verifiers accept this issuer.

consentScopes.$comment: Consent grants scope disclosure of hkt-profcred-v1 claims to these relying-party categories (POST /didvc/consent-grants).
